notes: Single-stage: recover original filenames from standard-base64 (padded, validated) obfuscated .qtn quarantine names, skip a battery of decoys (invalid alphabet/length/padding, NUL and '/' decodes, non-UTF-8 decodes, missing suffix, empty segment), restore file bytes byte-identically, and emit a sorted manifest. Exercises C-fa0e8ff2 (decode a base64 filename back to the original name) at easy; the verifier embeds an independent reference decoder and checks the manifest, byte-equality and exit status on the visible run plus three hidden quarantines (mixed, mostly-decoy, all-decoy). Small nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness.
